kids_evidence: Not a children's app. Spec user: 'a person in a home or small office whose Wi-Fi is fine in one room and bad in another' (WiFiTrail.md:36). store/apps/WiFiTrail.json primary_category = UTILITIES. No Kids or Families field.

banner.where: lib/features/trail/home_screen.dart:677 (HomeScreen, last item of the trail list) and lib/features/history/history_screen.dart:184 (HistoryScreen, last item). Both are hidden while a test runs (home_screen.dart:674, history_screen.dart:181).

interstitial.why: AglAds.onTransition is the default onTransition (lib/app/services.dart:100). transitionAfterNavigation (lib/features/trail/home_screen.dart:37-48) calls it when History (:228) or Compare (:239) opens, never during a measurement or within 1 minute after one (:33). WiFiTrail is a task-focused utility: the user walks room to room measuring, then opens History or Compare to read the result. A full-screen ad at that moment interrupts the task.

native.list_builder: lib/features/history/history_screen.dart:172 (for (final r in readings) ReadingTile; a for-loop in a ListView, not a lazy builder)
native.why: A real history list: one ReadingTile per measurement, growing over time, with search and filters (history_screen.dart:97-130). One small native after every 10th reading matches the uniform tile rows. It must use the same guard as the banner, `if (!services.measure.running)` (history_screen.dart:180-181), so no ad traffic shares the link being measured. Not in the Home trail list, the measuring sheet or Compare. Native unit ids exist in docs/admob-ids.json (WiFiTrail android_native and ios_native).

rewarded.why: Nothing honest to reward. There is no quota, premium tier or IAP (the grep finds none in the Dart code in lib/). CSV export (lib/domain/csv_export.dart) is part of the core job.

blockers: agl_ads is locked in pubspec.lock to 7b3c98e (resolved-ref, line 17), which does not contain agl-manifest cb21ee5 (checked with `git merge-base --is-ancestor cb21ee5 7b3c98e`). Run `flutter pub upgrade agl_ads` before using AglNativeAd / AglAds.showRewarded.

Age-rating answers: there is no store/ratings/WiFiTrail.json, so deliver_metadata.py:48 falls back to store/ratings/default.json, whose line 16 is "advertising": false, and passes it to Apple at deliver_metadata.py:75. This app does show banners. store-compliance should add store/ratings/WiFiTrail.json with advertising: true.
The spec left the interstitial as founder question 2 (money) (WiFiTrail.md:90). This file recommends remove.
